gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: same-industry peer shocks should transfer cleaner information than broad sector peer shocks when candidate and peer have similar liquidity, volatility, and relative-return profiles.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-018/024/025: Rolling-corr peer shock worked only after core-flow confirmation; accepted comparator is +0.3845 EV and +$6,107.66 PnL, so this replay scout must beat it to matter.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-001: Core-selected anchor peer lag had zero candidates, so this run avoids accepted-anchor dependency and uses free OHLCV industry groups.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-009: Same-industry consensus accepted-helper intersection was too sparse and negative; this run is candidate-pool only, not an accepted-helper intersection.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-023: Broad sector peer gap transfer had positive aggregate delta but failed old_thin and drawdown; this run narrows the relation to exact industry plus characteristic similarity.

gate_questions.3_single_policy_bundle: Only one decision hypothesis is tested: same-industry characteristic-similar peer shock candidate source. Runner, comparator, artifact, log, card, ticket, and manifest only evaluate that fixed replay-only bundle.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and the accepted rolling-corr peer-shock comparator is beaten.

hypothesis: A liquid same-industry peer's moderate gap-up plus volume shock may identify characteristic-similar industry peers with delayed next-open replacement value when the candidate has begun to participate but has not chased.
interpretation: The same-industry characteristic peer-shock source did not clear Gate 4 or did not beat the accepted peer-shock comparator; do not promote or locally retune this characteristic peer-shock family on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that same-industry characteristic similarity either remains a broad beta relabeling, becomes too sparse, or misses the pair-specific confirmation that made the accepted rolling-corr peer shock work. Do not answer by sweeping peer gap, volume, similarity, candidate return, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry requires materially new free or PIT relation evidence such as customer/supplier links, product-line text links, source-provenance event transfer, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Pure characteristic-threshold retunes should stay frozen.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping peer gap, peer volume ratio, characteristic similarity, candidate signal return, close-location, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Same-industry characteristic similarity is more specific than sector transfer, but it may still not encode the actual economic link or may remove too many usable rows. The accepted rolling-corr route likely works because the pair relation and core-flow confirmation are both present.
